newsitems.author: toshiyuki.sasaki
newsitems.contents:
[h2]Content[/h2][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/50b63f16c824ea54d450ab15a95c1b78d0f7c803.png"][/img]
・Event: Haunted Beach Shack: The Curse of Shirosato Beach[/h3][p]Duration: Until Jul 30, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/fb00b0fe610c312a669fe5cdcefbe3e8906c1f8b.png"][/img]
• 5★ Phantom Thief: Beachflower Minami Comes to Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts![/h3][p]Duration: Until Aug 13, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.  
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/7a76860374e491077319764987f6aef5417ab214.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Thieves' Secrets: Marian's Special Missions Now Available[/h3][p]Duration: Until Jul 30, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/52595e6119cf3f7567dcbfa93e77464d086d56f0.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Special Outfit for 5★ Phantom Thief Tempest Riko![/h3][p]The Special Outfit: Summer Riko Set is now available in the shop under Goods![/p][p]To celebrate the release of this special outfit, it is available at a discounted price until 1:59 AM on Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)! During the sale, the price is reduced from 3,200 Meta Jewels to 2,880![/p][p]*This outfit cannot be used by 4★ Phantom Thief: Riko Tanemura.[/p][p]*Outfit can still be purchased after 1:59 AM on Aug 13, 2026 (UTC).[/p][p]*Check in-game for more details.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/961e277ce03916a3d0658336780b853284c11882.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Revelation Card Customization Expansion[/h3][p]You can now customize the sub-attributes of any Revelation Card using the new items Elysian Ink and Prophetic Ink.[/p][p]Use Elysian Ink to select one sub-attribute, then use Prophetic Ink to generate a value for the selected sub-attribute.[/p][p]Generating a sub-attribute consumes 1 Prophetic Ink.[/p][p]Prophetic Ink is consumed each time a sub-attribute is generated, even before customization is finalized.[/p][p]Please note that any Prophetic Ink used will not be returned if you reset the card.[/p][p]*Elysian Ink and Prophetic Ink will be added as rewards from sources such as the Premium Phantom Pass and Premium+ Phantom Pass in future updates.[/p][p]*Once customization is complete, the card's mark, set effect, main attribute, sub-attributes, and attribute values cannot be changed.[/p][p]*Check in-game for more details.
[/p][h3]• Revelation Card Customization Expansion Gift[/h3][p]Available until: Jul 30, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]To celebrate the expansion of Revelation Card customization, we are giving away 1 Vicissitude Ink, 2 Elysian Ink, and 6 Prophetic Ink.[/p][p]*You can claim this gift from your in-game Mail.[/p][p]*Gifts will be removed from your Mail after the receipt period ends regardless of whether or not they have been claimed.[/p][p]　Please be sure to claim them within the designated period.
[/p][h3]• Wingbeat Coin Giveaway[/h3][p]Distribution dates and times: Once daily at 1:00 AM after maintenance on Jul 16 through Jul 24, 2026 (UTC) (9 distributions total)[/p][p]*The first gift will be available after maintenance on Jul 16.[/p][p]Available until: 14 days after each distribution at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]As a special gift for the Ver. 4.6 update, we will distribute 100 Wingbeat Coins each day for 9 consecutive days.[/p][p]Claim every gift to receive up to 900 Wingbeat Coins, plus a variety of other items, including 1 Coffee Aid and 1 MaraThon Energy.[/p][p]*You can claim this gift from your in-game Mail.[/p][p]*Gifts will be removed from your Mail after the receipt period ends regardless of whether or not they have been claimed.[/p][p]　Please be sure to claim them within the designated period.
[/p][h3]• Login Bonus[/h3][p]Duration: Until Jul 30, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]Log in on 6 days during the event period to receive a total of 7 Platinum Tickets!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/f4e5d005b11b3b1dbe9a671c18a80e3bcb7ece3d.png"][/img][/p][h3]• New Lineup of Crane Game Limited-Time Plushies![/h3][p]Available Until: Sep 9, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]　▽ New Side Story:[/p][p]　└Lamia[/p][p]　└Mini Narcissus[/p][p]*Also available from the Prize Counter, under the Crane Game menu.[/p][p]*The Ganesha and Mini Succubus plushies will be available until maintenance begins on Jul 16.
[/p][h3]• New Synergy Stories unlocked[/h3][p]　▽ New Side Story:[/p][p]　└Minami Miyashita
[/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and duration are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]

newsitems.title: Celebrate the 1st Anniversary of P5X with the debut of Hatsune Miku!
newsitems.author: s.omae
newsitems.contents:
[h2]Content[/h2][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/a0a5d9ee80b17d700fa9724d8c23602041f5f453.png"][/img]• Hatsune Miku Collaboration Event: Miracle Concert[/h3][p]Available until 1:59 AM on Jul 16, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.[/p][p] [/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/23ba2cad6c7af8380202d3edb577d0da85af1317.png"][/img]• 5★ Hatsune Miku comes to Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts! [/h3][p]Duration: Until  1:59 AM on Jul 16, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/e1bcb62c9c54df488de720cefc5e4e346f9b0395.png"][/img][/p][h3]• 1st Anniversary Party[/h3][p]Duration: Until 10:59 AM on Jul 30, 2026 (excluding certain content)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Special Gift[/h3][p]Duration: For 28 days from your next login between Jun 11, 2026 (after maintenance) and 10:59 AM on Jul 16, 2026.[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Special Anniversary Login Bonus[/h3][p]Available Until: 10:59 AM on Jul 30, 2026[/p][p]Log in for 12 days during the event period to earn a total of 10 Platinum Tickets and 5 Platinum Milicoins!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/610aaeddfd675a90546b394277b7b0f0e03cc20d.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Limited-Time Phantom Thief Anniversary Capsule Toys in Akihabara![/h3][p]Available Until: 10:59 AM on Aug 27, 2026[/p][p]Fill your Display Case with these limited-time capsule toys to relive the anniversary fun anytime!
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/1ec3b60b4565a37545bcd8202f063fcb1ca80e9b.png"][/img]
• Most Wanted Casting Call[/h3][p]Available: For 30 days from your next login after the Jun 25, 2026 maintenance[/p][p]In the Most Wanted Casting Call, you can select up to 3 exclusive 5★ Phantom Thieves, and draw from a Most Wanted Contract for any of them![/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• New additions to the Cognition Shop[/h3][p]Available until: 11:29 AM on Jul 25, 2026[/p][p]Meta Jewel x100 and Joy Medals x100 have been added to the Prism Cognigem tab of the Exchange Shop for a limited time!
[/p][h3]• New ways to obtain 5★ Phantom Thief Masaki Ashiya and his exclusive weapon[/h3][p]We've added a number of ways to get Masaki and his weapon, such as through Phantom Idol Draft X, Thief's Cognitite Shards, 5★ Cognitite Cases, and the Salamander Coin Exchange.[/p][p]*Salamander Coins can be traded for his 5★ Weapon at the Airsoft Shop in Shibuya.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/961e277ce03916a3d0658336780b853284c11882.png"][/img] • New Chat and Menu features[/h3][p]You can now customize your chat window frame, and the background design in menu screens.[/p][p]You can make any changes from the Edit Profile menu. [/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/055afdba0d9eb8ba826fb508b2c2c0ed6d06a19f.png"][/img]
• New Bonds[/h3][p]　▽ New Side Story:[/p][p]　┗ Minami Miyashita
[/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and duration are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]

newsitems.title: Ver. 4.2 Update Information
newsitems.author: toshiyuki.sasaki
newsitems.contents:
[h2]Content[/h2][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/f11747441ee3abacf9270cad4357bc6487d5e97f.png"][/img]• P3R Special Event: Met by Moonlight: Pierce the Night Sky[/h3][p]Duration: Until Jun 11, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/ba4c8f0b4c1c60ed5e7ca13ee1db946b86ecc2b8.png"][/img][/p][h3]• 5★ Yukari Takeba comes to Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts![/h3][p]Duration: Until Jun 25, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Trials from the Sea of Souls[/h3][p]Duration: Until Jun 11, 2026 at 1:29 AM (UTC)[/p][p]Ver. 4.2's Trials from the Sea of Souls will run for one week.[/p][p]We will be adjusting the rewards accordingly to match this duration.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/961e277ce03916a3d0658336780b853284c11882.png"][/img]
• New Thieves Den Features[/h3][p]You can now collect any earned Visitor EXP and P Medals in the Thieves Den without going to the Visitors or Information menus.
[/p][h3]• Assist Phantom Thief Capacity Increased[/h3][p]You will now be able to set up to two Assist Phantom Thieves.
[/p][h3]• Boss Difficulty Options[/h3][p]You will now be able to lower the difficulty of Strong Enemies and Bosses in Palaces 1, 2, and 3.[/p][p]If you are Defeated or choose to Retreat, the option to change the difficulty will become available.[/p][p]*Please note: Once you lower the difficulty, you will not be able to reset it to normal difficulty.[/p][h3]
• Gameplay Changes[/h3][p]　▽ Gates of the Nightmare Catcher[/p][p]　┗ When a member leaves their Companio, any points they have contributed towards the total for that Companio's ranking will be reset.[/p][p]　┗ When a new member transfers from another Companio, that member's points in the Companio's ranking (including their player points) will now start at 0.[/p][p]　　*Badge rewards obtained from personal achievements are not reset.[/p][p]　　*Stage rewards for player point milestones can still be claimed even after leaving a Companio.
[/p][h3]• New Additions to the Joy Medal Exchange[/h3][p]Added the Wonder-exclusive weapon Cyclotron and Cyclotron Shards, the special crystals used to forge it, to the Joy Medal Exchange.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/8d842eaabb3af70b6537e19ea772aa90637d5b96.png"][/img][/p][h3]• New Lineup of Crane Game Limited-Time Plushies![/h3][p]Available Until: Jul 16, 2026 at 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p]　▽ Plushies[/p][p]　└ Ganesha[/p][p]　└ Mini Succubus[/p][p]*Also available from the Prize Counter, under the Crane Game menu.[/p][p]*Alice and Mini Decarabia plushies will be available until the start of maintenance on Jun 4.
[/p][h3]• New additions to the Tycoon Points Exchange[/h3][p]　▽ New Items[/p][p]　└ Kamiyama's Invite[/p][p]　└ Yumi's Invite[/p][p]　└ Kotone ♦7[/p][p]　└ Kurotani ♣3[/p][p]　└ Shoki ♣2
[/p][p]*The above were previously planned for Ver. 4.3, as covered on the Persona X-stream #19, but will instead be included in Ver. 4.2.[/p][h3]
• Side Story Unlocked [/h3][p]　▽ New Side Story: [/p][p]　└ Toshiya Sumi[/p][p]  [/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and duration are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]

During the sale, the amount of Meta Jewels required will be reduced from 3,200 to 2,880![/p][p]*Outfit can still be purchased after 1:59 AM on Jun 25, 2026 (UTC).[/p][p]*Check in-game for more details.[/p][p][/p][h3]▼Persona 3 Reload Steam Store

newsitems.title: Ver. 4.0 Update Information
newsitems.author: toshiyuki.sasaki
newsitems.contents:
[h2]Content[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/0930b4a8e33df5924d5bbaa2967880809958f1ef.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Main Story Chapter 4: The Masks We Wear: Phase 1 is here![/h3][p]The following content has been added alongside the release of the latest part of the Main Story.[/p][p]　Content added:[/p][p]　┗4★ Phantom Thief Shoki Ikenami, along with his exclusive weapons (including 5★)[/p][p]　└Palaces: New Areas[/p][p]　└Mementos: New Areas[/p][p]　The Masks We Wear: Phase 1 Release Event[/p][p]　Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Jun 11, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]　*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/c6ac84a597cdebf712fcc28de6ff431b6a48e2fa.png"][/img]
• 5★ Phantom Thief: Manaka Nagao coming to Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts![/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Jun 4, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Shadow Hunt [/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Jun 11, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]You can view all the Strong Enemies available for a beatdown in new Palaces and Mementos from the event page!  [/p][p]Also, you can unlock the Path of Kaitul for Mementos even if there are uncleared areas![/p][h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/640557d75d9d871621502d4815132d76a66ce03e.png"][/img]• Event: Tycoon Typhoon[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on May 21, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]This is a 4-player card game where the winner is the one who discards their hand the fastest.[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Special Login Bonus: Anniversary Countdown[/h3][p]Duration: For 60 days after your first log in before 1:59 AM on Jul 16, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]As a lead up to our first anniversary in June, a special login bonus will be held.[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Login Bonus[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on May 21, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]During the event period, log in for 7 days to get 7 Platinum Ticket!
[/p][h3]• New Gates of the Nightmare Catcher rewards![/h3][p]Joy Medals and Konpaku Gems have been added to the Total Points rewards for Stage Rewards!
[/p][h3]• New Protagonist-exclusive weapon: Pheromone Sting[/h3][p]In the exploration rewards for the new Mementos areas and Chapter 4's Palace in the main story, the Protagonist's exclusive weapon Pheromone Sting and the special Shards used to forge it, Pheromone Sting Shard, will appear.[/p][p]Furthermore, Pheromone Sting Shard will be added to the lineups in the Companio Coin Exchange Shop and the Star Crystal Exchange Shop.[/p][h3]
• Space Revelation Cards lineup additions[/h3][p]The exchange options for items that grant Space Revelation Cards, such as Orange Fortune Revelation and Unknown Orange Revelation S, will be updated to include Hope.
[/p][h3]• Sun, Moon, Star, and Sky Revelation Cards lineup additions[/h3][p]The exchange options for items that grant Sun, Moon, Star, and Sky Revelation Cards, such as Fortune Revelation and Unknown Orange Revelation, will be updated to include Prudence and Ruin. [/p][p][/p][h3]• Revelation Card Inscription lineup additions[/h3][p]Nativity Space Revelation Cards can now be inscribed.[/p][p]Futility and Disappointment Sun, Moon, Star, and Sky Revelation Cards can also be inscribed.
[/p][h3]• Realm of Repression update[/h3][p]　└ (Added) Revelation Cards: Prudence & Ruin
[/p][h3]• New Synergy Stories unlocked[/h3][p]　└(Added) Manaka Nagao
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/606bcbf8352a48dab8950a900a9aaf57535a30a7.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Phantom Pass update[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Jun 11, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Complete the new seasonal missions to earn rewards.[/p][p]*With the season change, the EXP and level of the currently active pass will be reset at 9:59 PM on Apr 29, 2026 (UTC).
[/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and duration are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]

newsitems.title: Ver. 3.6 Update Information
newsitems.author: toshiyuki.sasaki
newsitems.contents:
[h2]Content[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/3d3c2172e7ee686ad9f3ccca3f2a681955d2d41c.png"][/img][/p][h3]• 5★ Phantom Thief: Goro Akechi coming to Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts![/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on May 21, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/b50d36273bf30b1e795124fd9eaa3740163aa799.png"][/img][/p][h3]• Persona 5 Special Event, Crossroads of Fate: Laboratory Arc Part 2[/h3][p]Duration: Until the start of maintenance on Apr 30, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.

[/p][h3]• Trials from the Sea of Souls[/h3][p]Duration[/p][p]Season 3: Until 1:29 AM on Apr 23, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Season 4: From 2:30 AM on Apr 23 until the start of maintenance on Apr 30, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Trials from the Sea of Souls will be divided into two parts in Ver. 3.6, with each part lasting one week.[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.
[/p][h3]• Gates of the Nightmare Catcher[/h3][p]Duration: Until the start of maintenance on Apr 30, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Gates of the Nightmare Catcher will be held for two weeks in Ver. 3.6.[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.[/p][p] [/p][h3]• New additions to the Joy Medal Exchange[/h3][p]Added the Wonder-exclusive weapon, Plasma Blade, and Plasma Blade Shards for forging Wonder's weapon to the Joy Medal Exchange![/p][p][/p][h3]• New Lineup of Crane Game Limited-Time Plushies![/h3][p]Available until 1:59 AM on Jun 4, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]　▽ Plushies[/p][p]　└ Alice[/p][p]　└ Mini Decarabia[/p][p]*Also available from the Prize Counter, under the Crane Game menu.[/p][p]*Black Frost and Mini Jack-o'-Lantern plushies will be available until the start of maintenance on Apr 16.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/2cce2060728058a2f159e0a3e74ce32c19969672.png"][/img]

• Event: Trial of Thorns[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Apr 16, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Take on powerful bosses in this high-difficulty event![/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.[/p][p][/p][h3]• Thieves' Secrets: Turbo's Special Missions[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Apr 16, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.[/p][p][/p][h3]• Login Bonus[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Apr 16, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]During the event period, log in for 7 days to get 7 Platinum Tickets![/p][p][/p][h3]• Trials from the Sea of Souls[/h3][p]Duration[/p][p]Season 1: Until 1:29 AM on Apr 9, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Season 2: From 2:30 AM on Apr 9, 2026 until 1:29 AM on Apr 16, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Trials from the Sea of Souls will be divided into two parts in Ver. 3.5, with each part lasting one week.[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.[/p][p][/p][h3]• Gates of the Nightmare Catcher[/h3][p]Duration: Until 1:59 AM on Apr 16, 2026 (UTC)[/p][p]Gates of the Nightmare Catcher will be held for two weeks in Ver. 3.5.[/p][p]*More details will be shared in a future announcement.[/p][p] [/p][h3]• New Synergy Stories unlocked[/h3][p]　└(Added) Mayumi Hashimoto[/p][p][/p][h3]• Side Mission Unlocks[/h3][p]　└(New) Chizuko Nagao[/p][p][/p][p]*Important Notes*[/p][p]• The event content and duration are subject to change without prior notice.[/p]
